reason: Use Tier 2: replace the ranking objective with pairwise logistic loss. Balanced BCE achieved the best reported macro HR@10 of 0.5387, while sampled softmax, attention, and causal mean memory failed to exceed it; this motivates testing relative ranking without softmax competition rather than adding more representation layers. The proposed loss is distinct from previous attempts and tests whether directly supervising positive-negative margins improves top-10 retrieval; the trajectory does not establish the cause of stagnation.
